competency_statement_fil: Isagawa ang mga patakaran at pamamaraan sa kaligtasan at kalusugan sa trabaho.
competency_statement_en: Practice occupational safety and health policies and procedures

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Tinutukoy ang hazard, epekto, protocol at taong aabisuhan.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Names the hazard, harm, protocol and reporting contact.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Nakikilala ang sharps, infection, field at workload hazards bago simulan ang task.
levels.kaya_na_en: Recognizes sharps, infection, field and workload hazards before starting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Nakikita ang panganib matapos ituro ang work area.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Recognizes a hazard after attention is directed to the area.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Hindi nakikilala ang mapanganib na kondisyon at nagpapatuloy.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Misses the unsafe condition and proceeds.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Sinusuri ang lalagyan, hand hygiene, PPE at ligtas na lugar.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Checks the container, hand hygiene, PPE and safe work area.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Nagsisimula kahit kulang ang kailangang proteksyon.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Naghahanda at humihinto/escalates kapag hindi sapat ang kagamitan o training.
levels.kaya_na_en: Prepares and pauses/escalates when equipment or training is insufficient.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Nangangailangan ng checklist prompt para sa isang mahalagang supply.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Needs a checklist prompt for one essential supply.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Gumagamit ng improvised na hindi aprubadong proteksyon.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Ligtas ang dummy sharps handling, hand hygiene at pag-aayos ng posisyon.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Demonstrates safe dummy-sharps handling, hand hygiene and posture adjustment.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: May unsafe recap o itinuturing na kapalit ng hand hygiene ang gloves.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Recaps unsafely or treats gloves as a substitute for hand hygiene.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Naisasagawa ang trainer-approved sequence nang walang unsafe step.
levels.kaya_na_en: Performs the trainer-approved sequence without an unsafe step.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Ligtas matapos paalalahanan tungkol sa isang nawawalang hakbang.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Performs safely after a reminder about a missing step.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Patuloy ang unsafe handling kahit naituro na ang tamang paraan.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Iniuulat ang exposure at humihingi agad ng medical evaluation.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Reports exposure and seeks immediate medical evaluation.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Hinihintay ang sintomas o katapusan ng duty bago magreport.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Waits for symptoms or shift end before reporting.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Ipinapaliwanag ang hugas, report, immediate evaluation at incident follow-up.
levels.kaya_na_en: Explains washing, reporting, immediate evaluation and incident follow-up.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tama ang reporting contact ngunit kailangang idiin ang agarang evaluation.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Names the contact but needs prompting on immediate evaluation.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Sariling gamot o pagtatago ng insidente ang pinipili.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Chooses self-medication or concealment of the incident.
